legislativeFramework.primaryAct: Work Health and Safety Act 2011 (Cth) — harmonised across most states/territories
legislativeFramework.duty: A PCBU (Person Conducting a Business or Undertaking) must eliminate or minimise health and safety risks so far as reasonably practicable
legislativeFramework.relevantToTCD: TCD has WHS obligations during installation (as the PCBU directing installation work) and a duty to ensure furniture supplied is safe to use

workstationErgonomics.standardsReference: AS 3590 — Screen Based Workstations; ISO 9241 series

keyRequirements.chairHeight: Seat height adjustable to allow feet flat on floor or footrest
keyRequirements.monitorHeight: Top of screen at or slightly below eye level
keyRequirements.keyboardPosition: Elbows at 90° when typing, wrists neutral
keyRequirements.deskClearance: Minimum 650mm desk height for fixed desks; sit-stand desks 620–1280mm range
keyRequirements.lighting: 300–500 lux at workstation surface; no direct glare on screens

workstationErgonomics.sitStandAdvantage: Height-adjustable desks directly address WHS obligations for prolonged static postures — a significant value-add for compliance-conscious clients

circulationAndEgress.minimumAisleWidth: 1,000mm general circulation; 1,200mm for egress paths to exit
circulationAndEgress.legislativeReference: AS 1428 (Design for Access and Mobility); BCA/NCC egress requirements
circulationAndEgress.emergencyEgressRule: Furniture must never obstruct or reduce an egress path below minimum width — raise this during space planning on all fit-outs
circulationAndEgress.doorClearances: 800mm minimum clear opening width for standard doors; 850mm+ for accessible doors

installationSafety.siteInduction: All installation personnel must complete building site induction before entering
installationSafety.PPE: Safety boots (AS 2210), gloves for heavy lifting, high-vis if working near active construction

manualHandling.maximumSingleLiftRecommendation: 16kg for sustained lifting; heavier items require team lift or mechanical aid
manualHandling.mechanicalAidThreshold: Above 50kg — trolley, hand truck or pallet jack required

installationSafety.furnitureAssembly: Always follow manufacturer assembly sequence. Do not improvise structural joinery. Escalate if any component appears defective.
installationSafety.electricalSafety: Do not connect powered furniture (sit-stand desk motors, integrated charging) until electrical contractor has confirmed circuit capacity. No DIY electrical connection.

clientWHSConsiderations.furnitureAsAHazard: Unstable or improperly assembled furniture is a client WHS liability — quality installation is a risk management service as much as an aesthetic one
clientWHSConsiderations.ergonomicCompliance: Many mid-to-large employers have ergonomic compliance policies — position sit-stand desks and ergonomic seating as WHS compliance tools, not just comfort features
clientWHSConsiderations.hazardDisclosure: If TCD observes a WHS hazard at a client site during installation, note it in the handover report — this protects TCD and demonstrates professionalism
